styleReferenceRole: Actual local files viewed at native resolution; no image generation or uploads.

stableTraits.Amos: Middle-aged, lean adult; medium-brown complexion, strong prominent nose, dark tight curls with gray, graying beard, coarse woven brown garments.
stableTraits.Amaziah the priest: Adult, broader build, brown complexion, black curls/beard, cream wrap and blue/cream clothing.

identityLimits: Only direct Amos/priest Amaziah portrayal is the existing Story. Amaziah king of Judah is a different person; Jeroboam I depictions are not Jeroboam II. National/ancestral mentions and Davidic restoration are not portraits. No new or aged portrayal; no same-person continuity break is introduced. Background sheep and unnamed attendants are not asserted to recur.

rows.alt: Imagined scene: Sheep graze on rocky hills beside a shepherd’s staff near Tekoa.
rows.reason: Sheep grazing among rocky pasture and olive trees with a resting staff illustrate Amos’s herding setting in 1:1. Coherent visible sheep heads, bodies and supporting legs; small or occluded limbs limit distant detail. Natural blue/green light and rough wool fit the style.

rows.alt: Imagined scene: A wooden cart stands loaded with grain sheaves in a rutted field.
rows.reason: Loaded grain sheaves, weathered wood, solid wheels and rutted soil illustrate the loaded-cart comparison in 2:13. Restrained evening color, coherent axle/shafts and woven bindings; no people or animals.

rows.alt: Imagined scene: Broken stone horns lie beside a ruined altar under gray skies.
rows.reason: Broken stone horns lie on the ground and the altar top has no standing horns, consistent with 3:14. Retain repaired v2; v1 remains inactive. Storm light, stone and hills fit the style; imagined altar form is not archaeological evidence.

rows.alt: Imagined scene: A dry vineyard and olive grove face rain falling on distant hills.
rows.reason: Dry vines, cracked earth and distant localized rain illustrate 4:7–9. Natural storm colors, olive trunks and stone terraces; no visible people or animals.

rows.alt: Imagined scene: A strong stream flows over rocks through a green valley.
rows.reason: Running stream over rocks illustrates the justice-and-righteousness comparison in 5:24. Natural blues and greens with coherent water flow; imagined metaphor scenery, not a claimed historical site.

rows.alt: Imagined scene: An empty ivory-inlaid couch stands beside a wine bowl and lyre.
rows.reason: Empty inlaid couch, wine bowl and lyre illustrate criticized luxury in 6:4–6 without inventing a named occupant. Wood, textile, pottery and strings remain coherent under subdued natural light.

rows.alt: Imagined scene: A weighted plumb line hangs against an ancient stone wall.
rows.reason: A vertical weighted line against masonry illustrates the plumb-line vision in 7:7–8. It does not portray or assign a body to the speaker in the vision. Natural weathered stone and cord are coherent.

rows.alt: Imagined scene: A woven basket holds ripe summer fruit in a quiet courtyard.
rows.reason: Basket of ripe figs and grapes illustrates summer fruit in 8:1–2. Coherent basket weave, fig interiors, vine leaves and fruit under daylight; no human or animal anatomy.

rows.alt: Imagined scene: Green vineyards and gardens cover restored terraces near stone houses.
rows.reason: Restored vineyards, gardens and houses illustrate 9:13–15. Retain repaired v2 with herbs, greens and onions instead of the earlier tomato-like plants. Natural green landscape and blue-gray sky; no David or ancestral portraits are implied.

rows.title: Amaziah Opposes Amos
rows.alt: Amos speaks with Amaziah at a sanctuary gate while holding a shepherd’s staff.
rows.reason: Amos with staff faces Amaziah at a sanctuary entrance, consistent with 7:10–17. Grounded daylight, textured cloth, brown complexions and natural curls fit the target. Visible staff grip, open gesturing palm, raised palm, hanging hand, arms and stance are coherent. Background attendants and sheep are small or partly occluded; no definite defect. Architecture and priestly dress are imagined, not verified reconstructions.
rows.generation: none; original asset and provenance retained
